faq: Will it send emails without me seeing them?
Not unless you ask for it. The default is that replies are saved as drafts in your inbox, so a person reads and sends them. Automatic sending is possible only for simple cases you approve.
Does it work with Gmail and Outlook?
Yes, both. It also works with most shared inbox and help desk tools. Tell us what you use in the order form and we confirm compatibility before starting.
How does it learn my reply style?
You share a handful of past replies you liked. We use them as examples inside the instructions so drafts sound like your team, and we check the first batch with you.
What happens to private or sensitive mail?
We add rules that keep topics such as legal, health or payment disputes out of drafting and send them directly to a person. You choose which topics count as sensitive.
desc:
AI email triage and reply drafts keep a busy shared inbox under control. Ecom Swift LLC connects your Gmail or Outlook account, labels each message by topic and urgency, prepares reply drafts in your voice and routes hard cases to the right person.

## What is email triage?

Email triage is the sorting step that happens before anyone answers. Each new message is read, given a topic label, ranked by urgency and sent to the right place. With an AI workflow, that first read is automated, and a draft reply is saved for common questions so a person only needs to review and send.

The key point is that drafts are saved, not sent. Your rules decide what happens next, and you can read every label and draft.

## What an unsorted inbox costs you

A shared inbox hides its own problems. A customer complaint sits beside a newsletter. A supplier question waits because everybody assumed someone else saw it. People spend the first hour of the day scrolling and sorting before any real answer is written.

Slow replies cost goodwill, and rushed replies cost accuracy. When the same ten questions arrive again and again, staff retype near identical answers. That repetition wears people down and leads to uneven wording from one person to the next.

## How triage changes your results

Faster, clearer handling means customers hear back sooner and urgent matters are not buried. Sorting by topic shows what people actually ask about, which helps you fix product pages, policies or instructions that cause confusion. Drafts built from your own past answers keep the tone consistent and cut the typing.

Staff attention shifts from sorting to judgment. They handle complaints, special requests and sensitive messages, which are the cases where a person matters most.

## What a good triage setup includes

- A connection to each inbox you choose, using limited permissions.
- Topic labels that match how your team thinks, such as orders, returns, quotes and suppliers.
- Urgency rules, for example a deadline mentioned or an angry tone.
- Draft replies for the most common questions, based on your past answers.
- Drafts saved in the inbox, never sent on their own.
- A named person who receives hard or sensitive cases.
- Filtering for spam and unsolicited sales pitches.
- A daily or weekly summary of what arrived.
- A short guide for changing labels and rules.

## What we do

We review a sample of your real mail and draw up the labels and urgency rules with you. Next we collect your best past replies and turn them into reply drafts for the questions people ask most. We connect the inbox, build the sorting steps and test them on old messages until the labels look right to your team.

The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in the number of inboxes, labels and drafts, plus filtering and reporting. We finish with a handover that explains how to adjust the rules yourself.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Share your honest worst-case messages, not only easy ones.
- Name a backup person for escalations.
- Read the first week of drafts closely and correct them.
- Keep the label list short enough to remember.
- Update reply drafts when prices or policies change.

**Avoid:**
- Letting drafts go out without a person seeing them.
- Creating dozens of labels that overlap.
- Including private customer data in reply templates.
- Ignoring the summary report, which shows patterns early.
- Using the workflow for legal or medical advice.

## Who it is for

A shop owner who answers order and shipping questions all morning can reclaim that time. A small agency with a single info address that several people share can stop messages getting lost. A service business with a support inbox that fills after hours can have every message sorted and ready by morning.

## What we need from you

Give us a list of the inboxes to connect, a sample of recent mail and a few of your best replies. Tell us who should receive sensitive messages. We never ask for your password. You grant limited access through your email provider, as a delegate or approved app, and you can revoke it at any time.
